name: Custom Watercooled SFF PC
tagline: Compact custom hardline loop in a Lian Li DAN A3. Small, cool and quiet.

specs.CPU: Intel Core i7-12700H (mobile CPU on desktop-form motherboard)
specs.Cooling: Custom hardline loop: EK Quantum 360mm rad, Bykski pump/res + LGA1700 CPU block

description: Built to be small, cool and quiet without giving up performance. The Lian Li DAN A3 is one of the smallest cases that still takes an ATX PSU and mATX board, and this one runs a freshly built, fully custom hardline loop: Bykski compression fittings, EK 45° and 90° fittings, an EK Quantum 360mm radiator, a new Bykski pump/res and LGA1700 CPU block, and an EK waterblock on the RTX 3080. The case has no proper pump/res mount in this layout, so I designed and 3D printed a PETG bracket that mounts it cleanly to a 120mm fan. It's one of one. Seven new 120mm fans keep the airflow strong despite the size.
highlights: Fully custom hardline water loop (CPU + GPU)
Tiny Lian Li DAN A3 footprint
Happy to show it running on pickup
